question:
There is a spelling error in the given sentence. Select the option that contains the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The choice of buying a yahct was poor.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"yahct"** is incorrectly spelt. (गलत वर्तनी)

 
 
• **Example: **The choice of buying a yahct was poor.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is **"yacht"**, which refers to **a medium-sized sailboat equipped for cruising or racing. **(यॉट)
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to spend the weekend on their luxurious yacht.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***yahct.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **buying** (खरीदना): The act of obtaining something by paying for it.

 
 
• **Example:** She is buying groceries for the week.
 
 
 
• **choice** (चयन): An act of selecting or making a decision when faced with two or more possibilities.
 
 
• **Example: **He made the right choice by choosing a healthy lifestyle.
 
 
 
• **poor** (गरीब): Lacking sufficient money to live at a standard considered comfortable or normal in a society.
 
 
• **Example:** The poor man struggled to make ends meet.
